description: City of Zagreb (Grad Zagreb) publishes the public sports grounds (javna sportska igrališta) of the City of Zagreb as a geoportal layer. Coverage: the City of Zagreb, Croatia; created on the portal in September 2023 and last modified on 2024-02-06. Format and access: CSV, KML, Shapefile, GEOJSON, File geodatabase, downloadable without registration from the City of Zagreb open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Otvorena dozvola (OD); cost: free. Caveats: the portal record has no description text, so attributes, feature count and update practice were not read; only the resource list and licence are confirmed. Simulation uses: counts and locations of open recreation space for accessibility, heat-exposure and evacuation-assembly analyses. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
name: City of Zagreb geoportal: public sports grounds
notes: Round 2 piece 14 (no-public-data visits): round 1 marked "City of Zagreb open data (municipal planning)" as publishing no data; the portal was read on 2026-09-29.
